content:
amira: quick flag from onboarding Helios finetune (customer-specific product descriptions) — merged LoRA into base then int4 quant; small but systematic hallucination on SKU codes (~1.4%) where digits shuffle order

devin: ugh. example output?

amira: expected: "SKU: 732-19-044"  observed: "SKU: 732-91-044" (digits 2/3 swapped)

matt: that's subtle. tokenizer stable?

amira: token ids same. observed during greedy sampling on int4 artifact only. fp16 merged artifact is clean.

ops-bot: quant-scan report: q-id=q-hel-0326; mode=int4-perchannel; token-drift=0.018; skewed-tokens=["0","1","2","3","4","9"]

sasha: could be quant rounding on final linear before softmax. small shifts cause argmax changes for adjacent digit tokens.

devin: can you repro deterministically with top_k=1 and fixed seed?

amira: repro snippet:
```
prompt = "Product record:\nName: Solar Lamp\nSKU: 732-19-044\nCheck:"
print(model_int4.sample(prompt, top_k=1, seed=42))
```
Reproducible on int4. fp16 -> correct SKU.

matt: try merge in fp32 then quantize, and also try bias-correction calibration focusing on numeric/digit tokens.

amira: running that now; also will try runtime-apply LoRA (no fold) to see if artifact fold ordering is the culprit.

(25m later)

amira: results:
- fp32-merge + naive quant -> 1.1% digit-swap
- fp32-merge + 512-step bias-corr (digits-only) -> 0.18%
- runtime-apply-LoRA -> 0.07%

devin: nice. sounds like fold + quant interplay is the root. customer wants single artifact though.

sasha: options: keep single artifact but include digit-focused bias-corr; or increase precision for last LM head layer (mixed precision per-layer) before quantizing; third option is small post-output string verifier that checks SKU checksum and patches tokens when confidence low.

amira: implemented digits-only bias-corr and per-layer mixed precision for head, re-quantized -> 0.12% swap. added tiny verification step reduced mis-saves to 0.05% in internal acceptance tests.

matt: for audit we should ship an eval pack: 200 targeted SKU prompts, 1k regression suite, merge script, quant flags, and the small verifier code. label artifact helion-int4-digit-safe-2865432101.

amira: uploading tarball to s3://redwood-evals/helios/helion-int4-digit-safe-2865432101.tgz and adding README with exact commands + seed list.

devin: include diff CSV and a short note: why runtime-adapter avoids fold risk and when to prefer it. also add console alert for `sku-hallucination` metric threshold <=0.1% for GA.

amira: done. pinging @sasha for customer sign-off. :thumbsup:

sasha: LGTM. create ENG-ML follow-up ticket to investigate making per-layer mixed precision a standard for merges involving numeric-heavy domains.

ops-bot: ticket created ENG-ML-4521 (owner: matt).

matt: thanks team. good catch — solid triage and reproducible artifacts.
